protocol.allocation: alpha / frozen family size / elementary components, two tails inside each scalar interval. Four components for contrasts, two for ceilings.
protocol.diagnostics: For each scenario and frozen family size, exact binomial excess-noncoverage and directional-error diagnostics use unconditional trial denominators and allocated alpha or alpha/2. Holm across all 90 diagnostics only after every locked trial completes. Conditional diagnostics and refusal counts also reported.
protocol.family_assignment: 1,10,32 cyclically by seed within each unchanged scenario; every claim retains its full allocation.

negative_controls.scope: Deliberately false variance or independence assumptions; outside the guarantee. Preserve every interval/error. These are not counted as valid-envelope qualification, and the method cannot detect all such violations.

protocol.remaining: Full joint-family simulations, separately locked power/resource/full-pipeline qualification and explicit frozen assumption/provenance contracts would be required before any product proposal. No repair of previously frozen BCa hypotheses or evidence reuse guarantees.
protocol.sampling: IID units with random Bernoulli(.5) membership. Paired units share heavy outcomes; complete IID entities use size-weighted sums. Event-weighted ratios remain the estimand.
protocol.screen: All 10000 qualification trials complete; no rejected error diagnostic; simultaneous exact availability lower bounds exceed .90 for all 30 scenario/family strata. These are implementation/operating-envelope screens, not a proof or power qualification.
protocol.variance_bounds: Exact unconditional unit-contribution population variances of the declared generator, plus 1e-12 for constant denominators. Never empirical variance, outcome extrema, or conditional loss variance used in place of zero-inflated unit contributions.
protocol.width: Report interval widths and truth-relative errors; conservative or uninformative intervals do not establish useful power.

scope: Conditional fixed-time mathematics requires true declared bounds and IID complete units. Simulation does not verify an external population assumption, prove useful power, enable the product, or repair arbitrary evidence reuse.
